content:
“Put it there!”

**Strong Arm** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *CAMP Revamp* update.

Thrown weapons fly farther.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | 50% increased throwing range. | 003701BC | 

- Before update 62, the perk provided 15%/30%/50% throw range and was named "Fire in the Hole." The perk also used to enable a throwing arc, which was moved to the game settings.
